The main takeaway from our work is that
the Asp9 Asn variant of LPL, the most common genetic variant in humans, has an important role in determining the progression of coronary atheroma.
the Asn9Asp mutation in LPL is a strong predictor of progression of coronary atherogenesis in patients with established atherosclerosis.
